announcements.title: Ministry Circular: Guidelines for Preparation of AIP 2027 & Budget Forecasting
announcements.content: All Heads of Divisions, Provincial Directors of Education, and Zonal Directors are hereby notified that the automated Annual Implementation Plan portal for Financial Year 2027 is now open for activity drafting. Please adhere strictly to Strategic Objectives SO-1 through SO-3 and ensure expenditure object codes align with Treasury guidelines.

announcements.title: National Guidelines for In-Service Teacher Training Workshops & Resource Person Entitlements
announcements.content: Organizing branches must submit workshop proposals at least 14 days prior to commencement. Only approved Resource Persons registered in the National Resource Persons Directory may be engaged, and trainee attendance rolls must be countersigned by the hosting Zonal IT Branch head.

announcements.title: Digital Verification & Evidence Attachment Requirements for Monitoring Audits
announcements.content: Under the revised Performance Management Framework, all physical progress claims exceeding 80% must be supported by uploaded evidence files (signed attendee registries, completion certificates, and photo evidence) before financial disbursement releases can be authorized.

aipTemplates.name: National Standard MoE AIP Template
aipTemplates.description: Official Ministry of Education Annual Implementation Plan format (Circular MOE/PL/AIP/2027). Prescribes standard Outcome No, Activity Code, Main Activity description, Vote Number, Allocation, Remarks, Indicators, Targets, and Responsibility.

columns.label: Outcome / Output No
columns.description: Strategic Outcome or Output numbering reference (e.g. 1.1, 2.3)

columns.label: Activity No
columns.description: Sequential activity code identifier (e.g. 1.1.1, ACT-01)

columns.label: Main Activities
columns.description: Full narrative title and operational description of the implementation activity

columns.label: Vote Number
columns.description: Treasury budgetary vote head from Government Estimates (e.g. 126, 127)

columns.label: Allocation / Estimated Cost (Mn)
columns.description: Total approved budget allocation in Sri Lankan Rupees (Millions LKR)

columns.label: Remark
columns.description: Operational notes, procurement conditions, or executing remarks

columns.label: Indicator
columns.description: Performance measurement metric or deliverable indicator

columns.label: Responsibility
columns.description: Designated implementing officer or desk officer designation
